# Porvenir Agencia Digital

> Software Engineering and UX Design agency specialized in AI Agents, Voice Automation, Mobile Apps, and High-Conversion Web Development.

## Overview
Porvenir Agencia Digital, based in Ciudad Real (Spain), bridges the gap between complex Software Engineering and human-centric UX Design. Led by Teresa Rodríguez de Dios (Software Engineer & UX Expert), the agency builds the digital assets that scale businesses: from AI voice agents and mobile apps to chatbots and high-converting websites. Projects across Spain and internationally, fully remote.

## Core Services
- **AI Voice Agents (Agentes Telefónicos con IA):** Autonomous voice agents that answer, qualify, and route incoming calls 24/7. The key solution for compliance with Spain's Ley 10/2025 de Atención a la Clientela (Law 10/2025), which requires answering 95% of calls in under 3 minutes. Enables businesses to meet the law without expanding headcount.
- **AI Automation & Chatbots:** Intelligent chatbots and AI agents for 24/7 customer support via WhatsApp, web, and social media. Built with ManyChat, Make (Integromat), and Zoho CRM. Includes LOPD-compliant conversational flows and automated lead routing.
- **Mobile App Development:** Native and hybrid iOS and Android applications built with software engineering rigor: clean architecture, AI integration, external APIs, and CRM connections. From business analysis and UX design through to production launch.
- **High-Conversion Web Design & Landing Pages:** Bespoke, high-performance websites built with semantic HTML, Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript — no templates, no plugins. Optimized for SEO, speed, and conversion. This website (porveniragenciadigital.com) is itself a product of the agency.
- **UX & Accessibility Audits (WCAG 2.1):** Technical evaluations and remediation for WCAG 2.1 compliance under Spanish accessibility law. Heuristic evaluations and inclusive design for public and private sector clients.
- **AI Training for Companies:** In-company workshops on practical AI implementation to increase team productivity and readiness for digital transformation.

## Key Technical Differentiators
- **Engineering Foundation:** All projects are approached from a software engineering perspective — performance, scalability, and maintainable code, not just visual aesthetics.
- **UX-First Strategy:** Every technical solution is validated through User Experience principles and conversion architecture.
- **Legal Compliance Expertise:** Specialized in Spain's Ley 10/2025 (Atención a la Clientela), WCAG 2.1 accessibility, LOPD/GDPR, and EU AI Act alignment.
- **Full-Stack Ownership:** Design, build, and delivery handled by the same engineer — no fragmented handoffs.

## Key Personnel
- **Teresa Rodríguez de Dios:** Founder, Software Engineer, and UX Expert. MSc in User Experience Design.
